evidence.note: Tests whether systems that translate natural-language reasoning steps into Lean preserve invalidity as well as validity, by automatically perturbing steps to make them wrong, and finds pervasive silent correction -- with the systems best at preserving valid inputs the most likely to repair invalid ones.
evidence.title: FaithformBench: Benchmarking Faithfulness of Mathematical Chain-of-Thought Autoformalisation

evidence.note: Uses 200 mathematical proof problems as a diagnostic, finding some reasoning models solve under 20% and cataloguing 10 fine-grained error types that numerical benchmarks hide.
evidence.title: Mathematical Proof as a Litmus Test: Revealing Failure Modes of Advanced Large Reasoning Models
